title: People who use paqad through the Claude plugin already have the old local search engine installed. Should this release replace it for them?
context: Chief architect gap (EX-application-architect-4): the plugin's background engine install reports already-present when any version of @huggingface/transformers is found, and its install marker stores no version. So plugin users who installed v3 keep v3 and its runtime security alerts (sharp, adm-zip, sprintf-js) after this release, even though the npm package moves to v4. Not answered by the issue or the resolved expert packets. Replacing it means a small change in src/core/optional-package.ts (remember the installed range and reinstall when it differs); leaving it keeps this change to dependency bumps.
